conf.comment: Post-processing for Akamai SIEM security events: rename rule fields to the Cribl Akamai SIEM Pack / OCSF / Splunk names, then shape the output. Attach this to a Route, after the parse_akamai_siem pre-processing pipeline.
Only needed if the final 'keep _raw only' eval in parse_akamai_siem is enabled. Harmless otherwise - it re-extracts the same fields.

Enable to emit one event per matched WAF rule instead of one per request. Required for OCSF Detection Finding, since each rule is a separate finding. Note this multiplies event count, and therefore Splunk licence volume.
Enable to output OCSF (Amazon Security Lake). Requires the cribl_akamai_siem_security_events_ocsf pipeline from the Akamai SIEM Pack, which is NOT part of this template.

conf.description: Rename Akamai rule fields to pack/OCSF/Splunk names and shape the output
